biotools.summary: Provides functionalities to translate gene or protein identifiers between state-of-art biological databases: CARD (<https://card.mcmaster.ca/>), NCBI Protein, Nucleotide and Gene (<https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/>), UniProt (<https://www.uniprot.org/>) and KEGG (<https://www.kegg.jp>). Also offers complementary functionality like NCBI identical proteins or UniProt similar genes clusters retrieval.
